title: 云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 六十六章 同舟云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 六十七章 浮沉
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
“当当”连声，金钵狂震，白素贞发出一声凄烈无比的尖喊，周身光芒爆放，刹那间竟化作一条巨大的白蛇，当空盘旋飞舞，嘶嘶吐信！
许宣脑中嗡然一响，如被雷电当头击中。
众人更是吓得魂飞魄散，连滚带爬地惊哗奔退，仓促间，几人被推搡摔倒，践踏惨叫。
明心道：“阿弥陀佛，现在你可看清了？这两妖女原是峨眉山上的蛇精，一白一青，各自经历了一千年、五百载，才修炼为人形。住持师兄慈悲为怀，念她们未作大恶，一直不肯将她们收伏。一念之差，始有今日之祸。小施主，你为色所惑，执迷不悟，就算今日侥幸不死，最终也必葬身其腹。”
许宣骇怒交集，不敢相信眼前所见，大喝道：“你胡说！她不是妖怪，是你使的障眼法……”
话音未落，眼前银光乱舞，“吃”地一声，右臂被易水寒的剑芒刺中，两仪炁刀登时光焰大敛。
林灵素喝道：“小子，别中了秃驴的奸计，专心念诀感应！”龙筋一紧，将他拽着冲天掠起。
法海朗声道：“许施主，出家人不打诳语。我师父降妖伏魔何止千数，这金钵叫做‘镇妖钵’，无论什么妖孽被金钵光芒罩住，必现原形。若非明空方丈与葛道人一再担保，这两条妖蛇早已被师父收入钵中，形神俱灭……”
许宣对峨眉众僧虽无好感，对这救过自己性命的少年和尚却有种莫名的信任。听闻此言，心乱如麻，周身寒毛直乍，突然明白为什么白素贞的肌肤总是那么冰凉，为什么她听到自己骂其冷血时会那么生气，为什么林灵素口口声声呼其小妖精，那夜在秦淮河上，她又为什么告诉自己看见小青了！
金光闪耀，白蛇蜷曲飞舞，众人喧哗惊叫全都听不见了，许宣胸膺如堵，脑中空茫一片，任由那龙筋拉拽，行尸走肉似的在剑光气浪里穿梭闪避。眼前一幕幕地掠过与她相识以来的种种情景……
他仿佛看见她旋身飞转，从箫管中徐徐落地；看见她蹙眉闭目，在闪电的蓝光里盘坐调息；看见她眼如春冰，满脸飞霞，嗔怒中带着难言的娇媚；看见她软绵绵地伏在自己的背上，如春藤绕树，发丝在清风里飞扬……
看见她站在桥上，衣裳鼓舞，夕阳与晚霞全都失去了颜色；看见她持剑冲入狱中，大声叫喊着自己的名字；看见她侧卧在起伏的长草里，似嗔似喜，脸颊映染着彤红的晨光……
所有那些纷乱的景象，连同着悲伤、震惊、愤怒、恐惧……犹如春江怒潮般涌上心头，从四面八方汹汹挤压，让他窒闷得几欲爆炸开来。
小青悠悠醒转，瞧见斜上方的金钵与白蛇，脸色大变，叫道：“臭和尚，快把我姐姐放了！”想要起身上冲，被那金光一撞，顿时又跌出两丈来远。
许宣一震，虽然已相信这二女是蛇妖所化，但想到法海所言，想到白素贞将被金钵消荡得形神俱灭，仍是一阵刀割似的剧痛，蓦地大吼一声，挥舞两仪炁刀，轰然猛劈在金钵上。
“当”地一声巨响，龙筋飞扬抛散，他眼前一黑，周身酥痹，体内的三股真气火山般喷涌怒炸，顿时平移倒飞，将尾桅、舱板接连撞得粉碎，接着骨碌碌地滚落舱底，晕迷不醒。
漫天金光炸散，旋风陡消。白蛇长尾抛扬，喷出一大口紫红的血箭，重重地砸落大江，巨浪掀涌。
小青大叫道：“姐姐！”扑到船舷，想要伸手拖救，却被陡然翻转的大船掀得仰身摔倒。眼睁睁地看着那银白的蛇尾消失于茫茫波涛，就像被人当胸剜了一刀，惊怒绞痛，无法呼吸。
那一瞬间，她眼眶湿热，视线模糊，竟有一颗晶莹的水珠夺眶涌出。她心中一颤，难以置信地看着掉落在掌心的水滴，悲喜交迭，想要朝着江中大喊，却哽在喉间一个字也说不出来。
姐姐，姐姐！你看见了吗？我终于也可以流泪了！那是我修炼了五百年，流出的第一滴眼泪……

甲板上众人尖叫迭声，接连推挤撞倒，滚落江中。法海不断地抄掠拉扯，也救之不及。
林灵素、李少微四掌交贴，急速飞旋，被那金钵冲天吸去。
易水寒、白璧双双急冲而下，想要夺扯林灵素，却与金钵光浪撞个正着，“轰！”绚光炸舞，顿时喷血翻飞，直落到数十丈外。
这一下相撞，不啻于道、佛、魔五大顶尖高手的真气正面对冲，不只这二道抵受不住，就连明心也喉中腥甜狂涌，金钵、禅杖双双脱手。魔帝、妖后周身剧震，彼此黏贴的左手与右掌顿时错分开来。
这两魔头以“盗丹大法”对峙了一昼夜，体内的真气循环一被打破，松开的两掌立时形成狂猛无匹的涡旋气浪，“呼”地一声，断木碎片螺旋飞舞，明心收势不住，翻身急冲而入，双掌不偏不倚地与二人对个正着。
“嘭！”又是一声轰隆狂震，气浪层叠爆舞，摧枯拉朽，竟比方才更加强猛十倍。
刹那间，大船的艉舱、舵楼、断桅、蓬帆……所有甲板以上的部分全都被夷为碎片，四炸纷扬。
小青磕磕碰碰地滚入底舱，与许宣一头撞在一起。只见上方天旋地转，人影纷飞，几乎所有的旅客都被掀入惊涌的波涛，就连法海也被震得冲起十几丈高，连着那闪闪发亮的金钵，坠向极远的江面。
“嗵嗵”连声，林灵素、李少微、明心三人将甲板撞得粉碎，滚落在她周围，个个面色惨白，大汗淋漓，显是受了颇重的内伤。
“盗丹大法”是魔门中至为隐秘的妖术，相传为远古苗帝蚩尤所创，能强行攫取他人辛苦修炼的内丹真元，化为己用，千百年来修成者寥寥无几。除了此法过于繁复玄秘，难以习成之外，更为紧要的原因，是其修炼与施展的过程中蕴藏的巨大危险，稍有不慎，就会两败俱伤，甚至经脉俱断而死。
林灵素与李少微的修为虽比明心略胜一筹，但经过昨夜一战，真气都已耗得不足六成。与明心对掌相撞后，每人的真气都不足与之匹敌，非但不能吸走明心的真元，反被其撞断奇经八脉。
相形之下，明心的伤势更加惨重。他误入“盗丹气旋”，虽侥幸没被吸去真气，但捱了两大魔头的合力猛击，经脉、骨骼寸寸碎断，几已成了一介废人。
此时小青已从悲怒中定下心来，凝神探听，风声猎猎，除了他们五人，船上再无其他幸存者。
朝西望去，大江上游更是人影全无，无论是青城二道也罢，法海也罢，都未曾追来，想来全被这惊天动地的气浪撞成重伤，自救不暇了。
她松了一口气，恨恨地瞪着明心三人，想到他们害得自己与姐姐吃尽了苦头，却也最终落到这等田地，悲楚恨怒之中，又觉得说不出的快慰，强撑着站起身，格格大笑道：“眼前报，来得快！姐姐，我来替你报仇雪恨！”
奈何寒毒未清，又被金钵、气浪接连震伤了经脉，全身软绵绵地毫无气力，方一用劲，气血翻腾，顿时又一跤仆倒在地，大口大口地呵着白汽。只好转而摇晃许宣，叫道：“小色鬼，快醒醒！”推搡半晌，却全无反应。
林灵素哈哈笑道：“小舟从此逝，江海寄余生。老子活了这么多年，快意恩仇，无所不为，又从全天下人的眼皮底逃了出来，早已不枉此生了。就算今日死在这江海之上，有屈原和你们这么多人陪葬，那也妙得很哪。”
李少微嘴角冷笑，闭目调息，只不理会。明心更是眼观鼻、鼻观心地端然盘坐，神色惨然，一句话也说不出来。
这几人之间仇隙极深，虽然现在伤重的伤重，昏迷的昏迷，没一人能聚气起身，但每个人心底都明白，只要有一人能够动弹，其他各人便大限临期了。当下各自凝神运气，都想抢在别人之前恢复伤势。
江水滔滔，大船飘摇跌宕，顺流直下。

小青调气逼毒了小半时辰，被大风吹拂，浑身打颤，越来越冷，初夏的阳光照在身上，竟如冰霜敷面，到了后来，终于掌不住靠在许宣身上，昏昏沉沉地睡着了。
迷迷糊糊听见有人惨叫，她猛地一惊，坐起身来，江风呼啸，日头已过中天，林灵素三人依旧动也不动地盘坐着，许宣亦昏迷未醒。
又听一声凄厉的惨叫从右边传来，转头望去，只见江面上漂着几艘残破的帆船，黑烟袅袅，横斜的蓬杆上仍有些未灭的火苗。船上横七竖八地卧了不少尸体，几人垂伏在船舷，双臂血肉模糊。
发出惨叫的是一个中年汉子，右手握刀，左臂齐肩而断，半边衣衫尽是鲜血，摇摇晃晃的坐在一大片浮板上，浑身发抖。瞧见小青等人，嘶声大叫道：“救命！救命！金鞑子放炮杀人，金鞑子放炮杀人！”

content_en:
"Dang, dang" was heard repeatedly, the golden bowl shook wildly, Bai Suzhen let out an extremely sad scream, and the whole body exploded with light. In an instant, it turned into a huge white snake, circling and flying in the sky, hissing and spitting out messages!
There was a buzz in Xu Xuan's head, as if he had been struck by lightning.
Everyone was so frightened that they ran away in panic and crawled on the ground. In a hurry, several people were pushed and fell, trampled and screamed.
Mingxin said: "Amitabha, can you see clearly now? These two witches were originally snake spirits on Mount Emei, one white and one green. They each spent a thousand and five hundred years cultivating themselves into human form. The abbot senior brother was compassionate and thought that they had not done any great evil, so he refused to subdue them. A single mistake in his thoughts led to today's disaster. Little donor, you are deceived by sex and stubborn. Even if you are lucky enough to survive today, you will eventually be buried."
Xu Xuan was horrified and angry. He couldn't believe what he saw before him and shouted: "You're talking nonsense! She's not a monster, it's a deception you used..."
Before he finished speaking, the silver light danced wildly in front of his eyes, and with a sound of "eating", his right arm was stabbed by Yi Shuihan's sword light, and the light flames of the Liangyi Qigang saber were greatly reduced.
Lin Lingsu shouted: "Boy, don't fall into the bald donkey's trick, concentrate on reciting the secrets and sensing!" The dragon's tendons tightened and pulled him up into the sky.
Fahai said loudly: "Almsgiver, monks will not lie. My master has subdued more than a thousand demons. This golden bowl is called the 'demon-suppressing bowl'. No matter what kind of monster is covered by the light of the golden bowl, it will definitely show its true form. If Abbot Mingkong and Taoist Ge hadn't repeatedly guaranteed it, these two demon snakes would have been put into the bowl by the master, and they would be destroyed in form and spirit..."
Although Xu Xuan had no good impression of the Emei monks, he had an inexplicable trust in the young monk who saved his life. Hearing this, I felt confused and had chills all over my body. I suddenly understood why Bai Suzhen's skin was always so cold, why she was so angry when she heard herself calling her cold-blooded, why Lin Lingsu kept calling her a little goblin, and why she told herself that she saw Xiao Qing on the Qinhuai River that night!
The golden light shone, the white snakes curled and danced, and the crowd's shouts and screams were all inaudible. Xu Xuan's chest was filled with fear, and his mind was empty. He allowed the dragon's tendons to pull, and he shuttled and dodged in the sword light and air waves like a walking zombie. All the scenes since we met her passed before my eyes...
He seemed to see her spinning around and slowly landing from the flute; he saw her frowning and closing her eyes, sitting cross-legged and regulating her breath in the blue light of lightning; he saw her eyes like spring ice, her face full of flying clouds, and her anger with unspeakable charm; he saw her lying softly on his back, like ivy around a tree, her hair flying in the breeze...
I saw her standing on the bridge, her clothes fluttering, and the sunset and sunset all lost their color; I saw her rushing into the prison with a sword, shouting her name loudly; I saw her lying on her side in the long and undulating grass, looking angry and happy, her cheeks reflected in the bright red morning light...
All those chaotic scenes, together with sadness, shock, anger, fear... surged into his heart like the raging tide of a spring river, squeezing violently from all directions, suffocating him to the point of almost exploding.
Xiao Qing woke up leisurely and saw the golden bowl and white snake diagonally above her. Her face changed drastically and she shouted: "Smelly monk, let my sister go!" He wanted to get up and rush forward, but was hit by the golden light and fell two feet away.
Xu Xuan was shocked. Although he already believed that the two women were transformed by snake monsters, when he thought about what Fa Hai said and that Bai Suzhen would be completely destroyed by the golden bowl, he still felt a sharp pain like a knife. He suddenly roared, swung his Liangyi Qidao, and struck the golden bowl with a bang.
There was a loud "dang" sound, and the dragon tendons were flying and scattered. His vision went dark, and his whole body was paralyzed. The three strands of true energy in his body surged out like a volcano and flew upside down, smashing the tail mast and cabin board into pieces one after another. Then he rolled down to the bottom of the bilge and fell unconscious.
The golden light exploded all over the sky, and the whirlwind disappeared suddenly. The white snake fluttered its long tail, spitting out a mouthful of purple-red blood arrows, which hit the river heavily, causing huge waves to surge.
Xiaoqing shouted: "Sister!" She threw herself to the side of the ship and tried to reach out to rescue her, but was knocked down by the sudden overturning of the ship. Watching the silver snake's tail disappear into the vast waves, it was like someone had stabbed it in the chest. It was so frightening and painful that I couldn't breathe.
At that moment, her eyes were wet and hot, her vision was blurred, and a crystal drop of water gushed out of her eyes. Her heart trembled, and she looked at the water droplets falling on her palms in disbelief. She felt sad and happy at the same time. She wanted to shout into the river, but she was choked in her throat and couldn't say a word.
Sister, sister! Did you see it? I can finally cry! That was the first tear I shed after five hundred years of cultivation...
Everyone on the deck screamed, pushed and knocked down one after another, and rolled into the river. Fahai kept plundering and pulling at him, but he couldn't save him.
Lin Lingsu and Li Shaowei put their palms together, whirled rapidly, and were sucked into the sky by the golden bowl.
Yi Shuihan and Bai Bi both rushed down, trying to grab Lin Lingsu, but they collided with the golden wave of light. "Boom!" The brilliant light exploded, blood spurted out, and they fell dozens of feet away.
This collision was like a head-on confrontation between the true qi of the five top masters of Taoism, Buddhism, and Demonology. Not only were these two Taoists unable to withstand it, but even Mingxin felt a sweet and fishy sensation surge in his throat, and both the golden bowl and the Zen staff fell out of their hands. The Demon Emperor and Demon Queen's whole bodies were shaken violently, and their left and right palms that were attached to each other suddenly separated.
The two demons faced each other for a whole day and night using the "Elixir Stealing Technique". As soon as the circulation of true energy in the body was broken, the two released palms immediately formed a violent vortex of air waves. With a "whoosh", broken wood fragments flew in a spiral. Mingxin couldn't hold back, turned over and rushed in, facing the two of them squarely with both palms.
"Bang!" There was another roaring sound, and the waves of air exploded and exploded, destroying everything, and it was actually ten times more powerful than before.
In an instant, the ship's stern cabin, helm tower, broken masts, sails...all the parts above the deck were reduced to pieces and exploded in all directions.
Xiaoqing rolled into the bottom cabin with a bump and bumped into Xu Xuan. I saw the sky spinning above me, people flying around, almost all the passengers were thrown into the surging waves, and even Fa Hai was shaken up to a height of more than ten feet, and with the shining golden bowl, it fell to the far surface of the river.
"Boom, boom!" Lin Lingsu, Li Shaowei, and Mingxin smashed the deck into pieces and rolled around her. They all looked pale and sweating profusely, showing that they had suffered serious internal injuries.
The "Stealing Pill Technique" is the most secret magic among the demon sect. According to legend, it was created by the ancient Miao Emperor Chi You. It can forcibly seize the inner elixir essence that others have worked hard to cultivate and turn it into their own use. Over the thousands of years, only a few people have mastered it. In addition to the fact that this method is too complicated and mysterious to be practiced, the more important reason is that the process of practicing and performing it contains huge dangers. If you are not careful, both sides will be injured, and even your meridians will be severed and die.
Although Lin Lingsu and Li Shaowei were slightly better than Ming Xin in cultivation, after last night's battle, less than 60% of their true energy was consumed. After colliding with Mingxin's palms, each person's true energy was not enough to match it. Not only could they not absorb Mingxin's true energy, but they were knocked out by it and broke the eight extraordinary meridians.
In comparison, Mingxin's injuries were even more serious. He accidentally entered the "Elixir Stealing Cyclone", and although he was lucky enough not to be sucked out of his true energy, he was hit hard by the combined force of the two demons. His meridians and bones were shattered, and he was almost a cripple.
At this time, Xiaoqing had calmed down from her grief and anger, and listened intently, hunting for the wind. Apart from the five of them, there were no other survivors on the ship.
Looking to the west, there was no one in the upper reaches of the river. Neither the Qingcheng Erdao nor Fahai came after them. It was thought that they were all seriously injured by the earth-shattering air waves and had no time to save themselves.
She breathed a sigh of relief and glared at Ming Xin and the others hatefully, thinking that they had caused her and her sister to suffer so much, but they ended up in this situation. She was filled with grief, anger, and at the same time felt indescribable relief. She stood up and laughed loudly: "The retribution came quickly!Sister, let me avenge you! "
However, before the cold poison was cleared, the meridians were injured by the golden bowl and the air waves one after another. His whole body was limp and powerless. As soon as he exerted force, his energy and blood surged, and he fell to the ground again, breathing heavily in white steam. He had no choice but to turn around and shake Xu Xuan, shouting: "Little pervert, wake up! "I pushed and pushed for a long time, but there was no response at all.
Lin Lingsu laughed and said: "The boat passed away from now on, and the rivers and seas left me with the rest of my life. I have lived for so many years, doing whatever it takes to grudge and grudge, and I have escaped from the eyes of everyone in the world. This life has long been lived in vain. Even if I die today on this river and sea, with Qu Yuan and so many of you buried with me, that would be wonderful. "
Li Shaowei sneered, closed his eyes, adjusted his breath, and just ignored it. Ming Xin sat in the cross-legged position with her eyes on her nose and her nose on her heart, with a miserable look on her face, unable to say a word.
There is a deep hatred between these people. Although they are seriously injured and unconscious, no one can gather the energy to get up, but everyone knows deep down that as long as one person can move, the rest of them will die. At the moment, everyone is focusing on their luck, trying to recover from their injuries before others.
The river was surging, and the ship was bouncing and going straight down the river.
Xiao Qing adjusted her Qi to poison for half an hour. She was trembling all over due to the strong wind and getting colder and colder. The early summer sun shone on her body and it was like frost covering her face. Finally, she couldn't help but lean on Xu Xuan and fell asleep drowsily.
She vaguely heard someone screaming. She was startled and sat up. The river wind was howling and the sun had passed the zenith. Lin Lingsu and the other three were still sitting cross-legged motionless. Xu Xuan was also unconscious.
Hearing another shrill scream coming from the right, he turned around and saw several broken sailboats floating on the river. Black smoke curled up, and there were still some unextinguished flames on the horizontal tent poles. There were many corpses lying strewn about the ship, and several people were hanging on the side of the ship, their arms bloody and bloody.
The one who screamed was a middle-aged man, holding a knife in his right hand, his left arm was broken at the shoulder level, half of his clothes were covered in blood, and he was sitting on a large floating board precariously, shaking all over. When he saw Xiao Qing and others, he yelled: "Help! Help! The Golden Tartars fired cannons to kill people, the Golden Tartars fired cannons to kill people! "
